name: Maroma, A Belmond Hotel
insider_take: This secluded Riviera Maya sanctuary sits on one of Mexico's most pristine beaches, where ancient Mayan ruins meet world-class luxury in perfect harmony.
whats_special: Maroma boasts direct access to the Mesoamerican Reef, the second-largest coral reef system in the world. The hotel's beachfront was once a sacred Mayan trading route, and you can still find ancient cenotes (natural sinkholes) within minutes of the property. The resort's signature spa treatments incorporate traditional Mayan healing rituals passed down through generations.
pro_tip: Book the sunrise snorkeling excursion to have the reef practically to yourself – the marine life is most active in the early morning hours, and you'll avoid the crowds from other resorts.
dont_miss: The hotel's exclusive access to hidden cenote Dos Ojos for private swimming experiences, and the weekly Mayan fire ceremony performed on the beach under the stars. The resort's organic garden supplies ingredients for their award-winning restaurants, including rare heirloom varieties of cacao used in traditional chocolate ceremonies.
pros: Pristine white sand beach on the Riviera Maya
World-class spa with traditional Mayan treatments
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Gourmet dining featuring authentic Mexican cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Secluded location requires transportation for off-resort activities
